basis.known_condition: 20kg probe / former train-5 geometry and seed, NOT frozen research A/B/C

logical_scope: For THIS measured initial state and immutable queued commands, new motor controls issued only after failure cannot alter the observed first10ms plant trajectory before20ms latency. Keeping the same exit/gates therefore cannot avoid THIS refusal merely by changing post-failure motor control.
not_claimed: Not every20kg box or seed is unrecoverable
Measured instantaneous acceleration is not a certified future bound
No proof that a new PUSH governor makes recovery universally safe

A.name: Preserve original PUSH execution; domain-limited recovery
A.effect: Keep original control and all failures. Recover only admitted domain; outside-domain episodes censor. Do not claim general recovery/full-task acceptance.

B.name: Frozen skill weights plus explicit protection/braking layer DURING PUSH
B.effect: Change the executed option protocol while PUSH still owns authority, before its immutable pending commands make recovery infeasible. Needs separate source/protocol/data-distribution/label and new heldout validation; all old failures/goals/history preserved, no threshold relaxation.

recommendation: B if the requirement is broader continuous no-reset recovery; A if strict original-PUSH execution and narrow fixed-option prediction remain the priority.
